Test fixtures for route and photo import scenarios.

Contents:
- `test_linestring.geojson` - sample LineString route import
- `test_points.geojson` - sample Point FeatureCollection import
- `test_photo_1.jpg` - JPEG with EXIF GPS metadata
- `test_photo_2.jpg` - JPEG with EXIF GPS metadata
- `test_photo_no_gps.jpg` - JPEG without GPS metadata

These files are intentionally tracked and should stay out of the repository root.
